summary: Tested RBAC (operador/supervisor/pcp), /pcp phase chips + previsão, /pcp/acompanhar, operador own-counter cards, relatórios/exports and mobile layout. Pytest: 53/53 passed (operador checks run with 1025, see context). Playwright covered desktop supervisor flow and 390px mobile for PCP user, acompanhar and operador. Core features work. Issues found: (1) the login matrícula input is type=number, so the alphanumeric accounts TEST_SUP/TEST_PCP cannot be typed in a real browser; (2) the PCP table Progresso column uses the old formula and shows 0% while acompanhar shows 50% for OP-002; (3) /api/roteiro/<id> is captured by the k8s ingress (goes to FastAPI and returns 404), so the roteiro edit fetch is broken in preview; (4) minor design issues.

minor.issue: Through the preview URL, all /api/* goes to port 8001 (FastAPI) and returns {"detail":"Not Found"} 404. It works on localhost:3000. The JS fetch('/api/roteiro/'+id) at mes_aps.py:1461 (roteiro edit) is therefore broken in preview. RBAC for this path could not be verified externally. Suggest renaming it to something like /supervisor/api/roteiro/<id>.
No login check (anonymous users can read the pending count). Low risk.

ui_bugs.issue: <input type=number name=matricula> rejects letters, so TEST_SUP and TEST_PCP (and any alphanumeric matrícula) cannot log in through the UI. Playwright fill fails with 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]'. Change to type=text inputmode=numeric.

Formula is (meta - SUM(saldos))/meta. For multi-phase OPs it is 0% (OP-002 shows 0.0% while /pcp/acompanhar shows 50.0%). Use the same formula as acompanhar: (meta*nfases - soma saldos)/(meta*nfases). The column also lacks a data-testid.

issues: OPs em Andamento table is wider than the card: the Ações column ('🎯 Fases' button) is clipped at the right edge. Wrap the table in an overflow-x:auto container.
Export links (OEE XLSX/PDF, Pareto, Aging, Prod.) are dark-blue underlined text on a dark background, very low contrast
Shows the test credentials hint 'Teste: 1024, 1025, 1026 Senha: 123456' publicly
The hidden burger menu with 11 /supervisor links is rendered in the DOM for operador/pcp users. It is not visible and the routes are protected, but it is better to render it only for supervisors.

action_items: Change login matrícula input from type=number to type=text (inputmode=numeric) so TEST_SUP/TEST_PCP and alphanumeric matrículas can log in
Fix PCP table Progresso formula to match acompanhar (meta*nfases) and add a data-testid
Move /api/roteiro/<id> to a non-/api path (preview ingress sends /api to FastAPI on 8001) and update the fetch at line ~1461 and AREAS_SUPERVISOR
Wrap the /pcp OPs table in an overflow-x:auto container for mobile
Improve contrast of the export links on /supervisor/relatorios
critical_code_review_comments: exigir_supervisor returns early when there is no session and relies on each route's inline login check. All checked routes have one, but a decorator would be safer.
The role check startswith('/pcp') would also match any future route like '/pcpxyz'. Prefer path == '/pcp' or startswith('/pcp/').
mes_aps.py is 3700+ lines with inline templates. It should be split into modules.
operador(): DATE('now') in SQLite is UTC while data_hora_inicio uses local datetime.now(). This is fine on a UTC pod but would drift in other timezones.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (only works when the input type is changed via JS, plus the progress mismatch)

test_credentials: 1024 is NO LONGER an operador: the real owner (1000, via Google) changed 1024's papel operador→pcp at 2026-11-08 15:09:44 (audit_log id 117) during testing. I did not revert it because it is the user's data. Operador tests used 1025/123456. /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not list TEST_SUP/TEST_PCP; add them.
seed_data_creation: None. No OPs, apontamentos or users were created or modified. The denied POSTs (/pcp/nova, /supervisor/operador/reset/1026) were rejected before reaching the handler.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flask app on port 3000 behind the preview URL. /api/* does not reach Flask. Run tests/test_rbac_pcp.py (xdist is configured in pytest.ini). In Playwright, the login input needs JS type='text' to enter TEST_ users until it is fixed. The pod clock is Nov 2026, so many phases show as parada. Use 1025 as the operador.
